title: Stop the Engram test launcher from printing "registered-but-not-indexed … not host check credit" for runs whose record is delivered normally
outcome: Stop the Engram test launcher from printing "registered-but-not-indexed … not host check credit" for runs whose record is delivered normally
acceptance: A focused --input commit run registered with the TermAl host, whose host index has not yet caught up at admission, no longer reports that it earns no host check credit; the launcher either says registration succeeded and credit is decided at delivery, or re-queries briefly before reporting
A launcher test covers the registration-only response path and asserts the new wording, and the untracked and unconfirmed states keep their existing messages

completion.summary: Corrected registration-only credit wording, preserved fallback wording, and landed the reviewed registration diagnostics changeset. Focused committed-input acceptance and exact FULL passed; installed build is ready on all six stores.
